author: mk
title: Looking for artist for DND character sketches
content: Hi! I’m looking for an artist to work on a large project. I’m looking for sketches for a bunch of my DND characters, both with and without their outfits (but in underwear) to show body type. Looking for someone comfortable with anatomy. I think it’d be about 25 sketches in all. Some notes: want someone comfortable drawing a variety of scars/injuries (including one character missing her eyes. Not detailed injury but empty sockets) - comfortable with a variety of body types (including one character that’s underweight and malnourished) - two of the characters appear underage (one is a teenager and the other appears as a preteen but is mentally older). Nonsexualized but in minimal clothing to show body type. Willing to put them in a tank + shorts if preferable. option to get colored version depending on price —but aware that that’s probably outside of my budget. Contact: reply to the post or DM.
